what_would_NOT_change.serialization of existing records: unchanged; new records would need their own schema strings

what_would_NOT_change.grid-based behaviour: unchanged: the grid route is not modified
what_would_NOT_change.trust/admission semantics: unchanged for grid rows; the new route must also refuse inadmissible forward points (None) exactly as calibrate does

phase8_compatibility.semantic_classification: ADDITIVE / MINOR: no existing call, record, digest or verdict changes
phase8_compatibility.executable_classification: NOT A DESCENDANT OF CORE FREEZE V1: every path that makes the capability a public or certified Core contract fails a binding check of the V1 verifier
phase8_compatibility.verdict_reason: docs/CORE_FREEZE_POLICY.md section 10 states a later commit that fails a contract check is not a descendant of Core Freeze V1, and contract.api binds the exact frozen digest and total count. The extension is compatible for callers, but it cannot be delivered as Core under the V1 manifest; it needs a new freeze manifest (and a certificate reissue if placed in inference/ or adequacy/). The only verifier-passing Core location (non-exported uq/) is rejected on scientific grounds.
